Senior AI Engineer

Belfast, United Kingdom

Job ID 10740BRPermanentHybrid

Job description

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior AI Engineer (Manager) to join our IT (EA & Technology Platforms) team, based in A&O Shearman's Belfast office.

What you will do

Reporting to the AI Platform Owner, this role will be a senior technical leader responsible for the strategy, design, and implementation of advanced AI and ML use cases across the firm.

  • Work with senior stakeholders from business teams to understand AI use cases mapping to business outcomes.
  • Facilitate regular service provider reviews to assess performance against service targets.
  • Actively identify and pursue opportunities for continuous improvement.

What you will have

  • Experience in machine learning, deep learning, and AI model development
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or C-Sharp.
  • Experience leveraging AI code-writing assistants with appropriate engineering controls.
  • Proven track record of managing large global teams.

NO AGENCIES PLEASE - A&O Shearman does not accept unsolicited CVs.
